rows.jyutping: hou2 jau5 ji6 gwok3 fung1 cing4 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing something done or presented in an exotic manner.

example.english: They decorated the restaurant exotically, making me feel as if I were travelling.
example.traditional: 佢將間餐廳布置到好有異國風情咁，搞到我以為去咗旅行。
